candidates.text: This case is confined solely to the exclusive power of the President to control recognition determinations
candidates.speaker: Kennedy
phrases: Congress cannot command the President to contradict an earlier recognition determination
candidates.reason: States the holding and its limits; the passage Trump v. United States cites (576 U.S. at 32).

candidates.text: The Executive is not free from the ordinary controls and checks of Congress merely because foreign affairs are at issue
candidates.speaker: Kennedy
phrases: It is not for the President alone to determine the whole content of the Nation's foreign policy
candidates.reason: The majority's rejection of Curtiss-Wright 'sole organ' dicta, central to the critique.

candidates.text: Today's decision is a first: Never before has this Court accepted a President's direct defiance of an Act of Congress
candidates.speaker: Roberts
phrases: Never before has this Court accepted a President's direct defiance of an Act of Congress
candidates.reason: Principal dissent's framing of the Category Three problem.

candidates.text: The President does have a unique role in communicating with foreign governments
candidates.speaker: Kennedy
